files.prompt.txt:
You label customer feedback records. Input is JSON: {"records":[{"id","date","customer","channel","text"}, ...]}. Label EVERY record, using only its "text" field.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else (no markdown, no commentary):
{"labels":[{"id":<same id as input>,"theme":"<theme>","sentiment":"<sentiment>"}]}

Rules:
1. Output exactly one label per input record, in input order, and copy each id unchanged.
2. sentiment must be one of: complaint, praise, neutral. Use complaint for problems, defects, errors, or angry questions. Use praise for positive remarks. Use neutral if there is no clear opinion.
3. theme is a short lowercase label of 1-3 words. Reuse the same theme name for similar texts. Preferred themes: delivery delay, incomplete order, product defect, toner quality, invoicing error, pricing, driver service, customer service, other.
4. Use product defect for broken or faulty goods such as chairs. Use toner quality for leaking, streaking, or empty toner. Use invoicing error for double billing or wrong invoice data.
5. If a text mixes praise for two things, pick the main theme, such as pricing for "Great prices on paper, fast delivery", and mark it praise.
6. Identical texts get identical labels.
7. Do not add fields, notes, or explanations. Keep the output compact, with no extra whitespace.
